provenance: Business ideas generated by KIP's K-BIG-2 engine from structured user profiles, plus manually maintained sector data. These are model-generated concept records, not observed transaction or survey data. Every estimated column below states its basis.

bases.exact: Arithmetic on stored fields. Reproducible from the CSV alone.
bases.rule: Lookup table in app/data/dataset_metrics.json. Reproducible, but the table is a KIP assumption.
bases.estimate: Lookup table plus an adjustment rule. Indicative only; not calibrated against repayment or market outcomes.

stored_columns: All other columns are KIP idea fields as generated by K-BIG-2 (for example monthly_revenue_estimate, break_even_months, required_assets). They are model estimates and have not been verified against market data.

working_capital_cycle_days.method: Category cycle (wc_cycle_days) plus up to 10 days scaled by the cost-of-goods share of revenue (cogs / monthly revenue).

seasonality_revenue_variance.method: Category seasonality_variance_pct, plus 10 points when environmental_risk_score is 7 or higher.

risk_index_1_100.method: Weighted score: 40% risk_level, 30% competition_intensity, 30% break_even_months scaled over 12 months. Levels map low/medium/high to 20/50/80.
risk_index_1_100.caveat: This is an index, not a probability of default. It is uncalibrated: no repayment outcomes exist to calibrate it against.

asset_depreciation_rate.unit: percent per year, average across non-stock assets
asset_depreciation_rate.method: Each required_assets item is matched by keyword to a rate: vehicles 20%, electronics 25%, machines and appliances 15%, fridges 15%, furniture and tools 10%, premises and structures 2%. Stock items are excluded. Unmatched items use 10%.
asset_depreciation_rate.range: 0 to 25, or blank if no non-stock assets.

grace_period_recommended.method: break_even_months rounded up, plus the category setup period (1 to 3 months).
grace_period_recommended.caveat: Derived from break_even_months, so the two columns are not independent.

job_creation_multiplier.unit: jobs (owner plus staff) per K10,000 of recommended capital
job_creation_multiplier.method: (1 + staff headcount) divided by (recommended capital midpoint / 10,000). Headcount is 1, 3 or 6 for staffing_requirement low, medium or high.
job_creation_multiplier.range: Positive number, or blank if capital is missing.

sdg_alignment.method: Category SDG mapping, plus keyword matches in the idea name and description (women and girls: SDG 5; water and hygiene: SDG 6; solar, charcoal and energy: SDG 7; training: SDG 4; health and wellness: SDG 3; youth: SDG 8), plus SDG 1 when the capital midpoint is K5,000 or less.

youth_women_accessibility_score.method: Starts at 10. Minus 2 if training is required, minus 1 if not home-based, minus 2 for physical-labour keywords in required assets or skills, minus 2 if the capital midpoint is above K10,000.

local_supply_chain_retention.method: Category local_retention_pct, minus 20 for high import exposure, 5 for medium, 0 for low.

gross_margin_percentage.range: Can be negative if costs exceed revenue. Blank if revenue or COGS is missing.

council_revenue_contribution.method: Sum of placeholder annual fees: business licence K1,000 if license_needed; health permit K500 if permit_needed; food certificate K300 if the category is food_and_catering.
council_revenue_contribution.caveat: PLACEHOLDER fees, not taken from a council fee schedule. Replace before any buyer relies on them.

capex_to_opex_ratio.method: startup_cost_estimate divided by cost_of_goods_sold_monthly. COGS stands in for operating costs because the schema has no fixed monthly costs.
capex_to_opex_ratio.range: Positive number, or blank if COGS is zero or missing.
capex_to_opex_ratio.caveat: Overstated for businesses with large fixed costs, because those costs are not in the denominator.

primary_supplier_dependency.method: First supplier rule whose keywords match required_assets, otherwise the category default.

import_exposure_risk.method: High if required_assets mention imported inputs (for example electronics, fuel, fertiliser, generators, printers). Otherwise Low for service-only categories and Medium for the rest.

notes: Every dataset row is a model-generated concept, so buyers should treat values as scenario estimates, not as observed market measurements.
The public export contains no coordinates and no user-identifying fields. Field-collected Ground Truth data is held separately and is not part of this dataset.
The dataset is currently small (18 rows in the first export), so category-level statistics are not yet representative.
